summary: Improve employee safety compliance with COM-B, safety coaching and reporting tools. Explore the five-day course and plan your training.
lede: Safety and health compliance motivation helps supervisors and safety professionals identify why workers follow or bypass controls. Designed for supervisors, safety officers and team leads, the course develops practical ways to strengthen safe work habits. Participants practise diagnosing task-specific barriers with COM-B, selecting interventions and using safety conversations, observations and near-miss trends to support follow-through.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who influence workplace safety behaviours or need to improve employee participation in health and safety controls. It is designed for people who already work with safety procedures and want a structured way to address day-to-day compliance barriers.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with workplace health and safety procedures, hazard controls and employee safety responsibilities is expected. No coding or specialist software skills are required; spreadsheet use is helpful for reviewing sample safety records.
